newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium lifts Dassault arrest warrant - Belga.
newsitem.headline: Belgium lifts Dassault arrest warrant - Belga.

text.p: The Belgian judiciary has lifted the international arrest warrant against French industrialist Serge Dassault, Belga news agency, quoting a judicial source, said on Friday.
A Belgian court last year issued the warrant for Dassault, founder and chairman of French defence firm Dassault.

The warrant was part of an investigation into claims that Dassault paid 600 million Belgian francs ($17 million) in kickbacks to political parties to secure a contract to fit air defence systems to Belgian F-16 jets in the late eighties.
Dassault has denied all wrongdoing but has refused to come to Belgium to answer questions.
The Belgian government has repeatedly tried to get more information from French authorities about the case.

Belga said it was unclear whether Dassault or the French were ready to provide more information about the case to the Belgian judiciary or whether Dassault would be willing to come to Belgium to be heard.
The court spokesman was not available for comment.
